name: io.github.printpronto/print-pronto-data
title: Print Pronto Data
description: US price ranges for custom stickers and labels; check if a print quote is fair.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Lists the products, sizes, finishes and quantities in the Print Pronto US Sticker & Label Price Index (November 2026). Takes no input. Read-only.

tools.name: get_price_range
tools.description: Looks up one job in the Print Pronto US Sticker & Label Price Index (US dollars, whole job): lowest listed, typical, fair range and highest listed price. If the exact job is not in the index it says so and returns the nearest jobs for the same product. It never estimates. Use list_products first to see valid values.

product.description: Product name, e.g. "Die-cut stickers", "Bumper stickers", "Roll labels".

size.description: Size in inches, e.g. "3 x 4" or "2 circle".

finish.description: Finish, e.g. "gloss vinyl", "matte vinyl", "white gloss BOPP", "clear BOPP".

tools.name: check_quote
tools.description: Compares a quote (US dollars, whole job) with the Print Pronto US Sticker & Label Price Index for the same job. Verdict is one of: below every listed price, below fair range, fair price, above fair range, above every listed price. If the exact job is not in the index it says so and returns the nearest jobs; no verdict is given.

quote_usd.description: The quoted total for the whole job, in US dollars.
